title: Income Records Mailing Allowance — Hardship and Protective Holds
content:
Under Hardship and Protective Holds, when updated household income records are asked for before a status review of a running Long-Term Hardship Hold, an income mailing allowance is added, once, to the days allowed for the income records. It depends on how documentation on the hold has arrived.

| How documentation submissions on the hold have arrived | Income mailing allowance |
|---|---|
| At least one by mail or fax, and none by the online portal or email | 7 calendar days (income paper allowance) |
| At least one by mail or fax, and at least one by the online portal or email | 3 calendar days (income mixed allowance) |
| Otherwise | None |

**Basis.** Every documentation submission received on the hold counts, whatever its kind, by the channel recorded for it. Mail and fax are the paper channels; the online portal and email are the electronic channels. A submission recorded as received by phone falls in neither group.

| Paper | Electronic | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 1 or more | 0 | 7 days |
| 1 or more | 1 or more | 3 days |
| 0 | any | None |

**Example (hypothetical).** The hold's documentation arrived once by fax and once through the online portal: 3 calendar days are added.
